answer: Make paid work happen inside network-metered sandboxes. Each key rents its own small compute slot by the hour, and a graded output counts only if the sandbox log proves it was produced there, inside that key's capped slot; the ledger marks such runs violet. A farm can't run one strong model on its private mesa of servers and fan the result out to many keys. Every fake identity must rent and fill its own slot, so a gale of sybil signups just buys a gale of rent, not extra reward.
